identityDescription: Approved Watcher skin identity sheet: original anime heroine in a violet short kimono-robe, white blindfold with a gold closed-eye sigil, magenta ribbons, gold-tipped staff (generated, not committed)
identityCues: a tall slender original anime heroine with a violet short kimono-robe with wide sleeves, a white cloth blindfold with a small gold closed-eye sigil covering her eyes, long loose hair with magenta ribbons, a long gold-tipped staff, dark leggings, bare feet, a small pointed chin and calm serene bearing.
palette: violet and royal purple, gold, magenta ribbon, slate-blue accents; saturated cloudless sky or one flat hot colour panel behind her; no red, no bronze.

styleReferences.description: Monogatari series second-season key art: extreme low camera angle, cloudless cobalt sky, white geometric masts, stacked diagonal figures (copyrighted, not committed)
Monogatari series close-up frame: huge flat eyes with crisp highlights, shard-like flat hair, fine linework, painted sea and cloud backdrop (copyrighted, not committed)
Monogatari series group frame: hard diagonal shadow cuts, cracked grey wall with one hot flat colour panel, geometric clutter, long limbs (copyrighted, not committed)

slayer_bowling_bash.name: Bowling Bash
slayer_bowling_bash.scene: A wide high swing of her staff knocks three enemy silhouettes over like bowling pins in a row, seen from a low angle with a cloudless sky and white geometry.

slayer_deceive_reality.name: Deceive Reality
slayer_deceive_reality.scene: She steps through a fold in the world: the frame is split by a hard diagonal where the two halves show mirrored views of the same room, her palm raised toward her golden-lit double.

slayer_fasting.name: Fasting
slayer_fasting.scene: She kneels calmly before an empty wooden bowl with her hands in her lap, a pale green light rising around her, emblem composition with calm margins.

slayer_master_reality.name: Master Reality
slayer_master_reality.scene: She shapes flat glowing geometric blocks floating around her with one open palm, calm face tilted, symmetric emblem composition with cloudless sky.

slayer_pressure_points.name: Pressure Points
slayer_pressure_points.scene: She presses one finger to a pressure point on an enemy silhouette's shoulder while small flat glowing dots mark points along its body outline, classroom-style shadow cut.

slayer_wave_of_the_hand.name: Wave of the Hand
slayer_wave_of_the_hand.scene: She waves one lazy palm and a wave of rippling pale violet rings rolls across the frame, long sleeve fluttering in flat shapes, enemy silhouettes sagging at the edges.

slayer_wheel_kick.name: Wheel Kick
slayer_wheel_kick.scene: A high spinning wheel kick seen side-on from waist height: one long leg sweeping a big flat circle across the frame with a flat gold impact burst at its end, her blindfold ribbons trailing, cloudless sky.

strike_watcher.name: Strike
strike_watcher.scene: A single clean staff strike: the gold leaf-shaped staff head slams forward toward the camera in a low angle, she leans into it with ribbons trailing, cloudless sky.

defend_watcher.name: Defend
defend_watcher.scene: She holds her staff horizontally across her body with both hands while a flat gold ring of light stands behind it like a halo shield, head tilted, hard shadow cut.

eruption.name: Eruption
eruption.scene: She thrusts one open palm forward and a ring of flat gold-orange flame spikes erupts outward from it, her jaw set under the blindfold, ribbons whipping upward, low angle.

vigilance.name: Vigilance
vigilance.scene: She stands serene with the staff upright in one hand and her other palm open, a flat slate-blue circle behind her, deadpan calm, symmetrical.

consecrate.name: Consecrate
consecrate.scene: She sweeps her staff low and a ring of gold light flashes outward across the ground to the horizon, enemy silhouettes at the edge of the ring, low camera.

empty_body.name: Empty Body
empty_body.scene: She exhales while her body turns transparent, only a thin outline left with loose leaves blowing through her, calm tilted head, emblem composition.

empty_fist.name: Empty Fist
empty_fist.scene: A bare-handed palm strike thrust straight at the camera with a flat gold circular impact burst around it, her blindfold and ribbons behind.

collect.name: Collect
collect.scene: High angle: she cups both hands as small gold and violet orbs gather into her palms from the air, ribbon pooling at her feet.

halt.name: Halt
halt.scene: She raises one flat palm to the camera in a stop gesture and a pale wall of light stands in front of it, enemy silhouette halted at the edge, low angle.

simmering_fury.name: Simmering Fury
simmering_fury.scene: Emblem composition: a small flat flame flickers above her clenched fist as her sleeve lifts, violet dusk behind, calm margins.

like_water.name: Like Water
like_water.scene: She stands barefoot on a perfectly still water surface with rings rippling from her feet, staff resting on her shoulder, cloudless sky above.

battle_hymn.name: Battle Hymn
battle_hymn.scene: She chants with her hands pressed together while a ring of small gold swords hovers around her like a halo, symmetric emblem composition.

mental_fortress.name: Mental Fortress
mental_fortress.scene: She stands with hands clasped inside a floating fortress of flat translucent geometric panels, a calm serene face, symmetric emblem composition.

rushdown.name: Rushdown
rushdown.scene: She charges forward with fists clenched, a flat gold flame silhouette trailing behind her and wind-stripes, low camera, magenta ribbons streaming.

nirvana.name: Nirvana
nirvana.scene: She floats cross-legged above a flat lotus shape with a ring of gold light behind her, small gold dots drifting upward, emblem composition.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.scene: Emblem composition: her gold closed-eye sigil glows on the blindfold while three small translucent windows floating around her head show glimpses of the future, tilted head.

indignation.name: Indignation
indignation.scene: She slams the staff butt into the ground and a ring of violet energy shakes the enemy silhouettes at its edge, clenched jaw under the blindfold, low angle.

inner_peace.name: Inner Peace
inner_peace.scene: She sits in meditation with her hands on her knees, a flat slate-blue circle behind her, ribbons pooling, still and symmetrical.

carve_reality.name: Carve Reality
carve_reality.scene: She slashes the air with the staff tip, opening a thin glowing violet slit in space from which a small golden blade falls, high angle, classroom-style shadow cut.

sash_whip.name: Sash Whip
sash_whip.scene: She snaps her long magenta sash across the frame like a whip, the sash a bold curved line with a flat spark at its tip, low camera.

conclude.name: Conclude
conclude.scene: She ends her stance with one long decisive horizontal sweep of the staff, a bright gold line cutting across the whole frame behind her.

judgment.name: Judgment
judgment.scene: She points one finger forward at an enemy silhouette while a ring and a single beam of gold light fall from above onto it, symmetric, stern tilted head.

ragnarok.name: Ragnarok
ragnarok.scene: She raises the staff and five golden thunder spears rain down from a dark storm sky onto enemy silhouettes, wrath stance, low angle, no red.

scrawl.name: Scrawl
scrawl.scene: She draws a looping glowing line in the air with one finger, forming abstract shapes (no letters) that float around her, a small amused tilt of the head.

signature_move.name: Signature Move
signature_move.scene: She strikes one dramatic finishing pose with the staff pointed to the sky and one hand on her hip, low camera, a spotlight panel behind her.

spirit_shield.name: Spirit Shield
spirit_shield.scene: A large translucent spirit guardian with wide arms wraps around her like a shield of ghostly gold, she stands calmly in front of it, symmetrical.

swivel.name: Swivel
swivel.scene: She stands upright with both bare feet planted in a wide stance, her whole body and both legs clearly visible, and pivots at the waist while sweeping the staff held in both hands in a flat spiral to block; flat spiral lines mark the turn and her ribbons spin around her, slightly high three-quarter camera angle, calm deadpan face.

wallop.name: Wallop
wallop.scene: She slams the staff down and the ground cracks into big flat shards flying up, low camera, hard diagonal shadow cuts.

wish.name: Wish
wish.scene: She kneels and cups her hands as a flat glowing star rises from them into the cloudless sky, ribbon drifting, calm tilted head.

deva_form.name: Deva Form
deva_form.scene: Emblem composition: she floats serenely haloed in a symmetric flat golden aura with wide wings of light, staff held vertical, calm margins.

omniscience.name: Omniscience
omniscience.scene: She spreads her hands as her gold eye sigil glows and a vast eye of light opens behind her, a constellation of tiny cards around, symmetric.

vault.name: Vault
vault.scene: She vaults over a white wall with the staff as a pole, a long arc across the cloudless sky, low camera, long limbs.

talk_to_the_hand.name: Talk to the Hand
talk_to_the_hand.scene: She holds a stern flat palm to the camera, a flat gold burst on the palm, enemy silhouette flinching beyond it, low angle.

tantrum.name: Tantrum
tantrum.scene: She stomps the ground with shockwave rings spreading, sleeves and ribbons flared in wrath, flat gold-orange panel behind her, low camera.

weave.name: Weave
weave.scene: She dances in a turn with the staff and her magenta ribbon tracing a figure-eight pattern in the air, elegant long limbs.

blasphemy.name: Blasphemy
blasphemy.scene: She bows forward with clasped hands beneath a dark violet sun, ominous and quiet, hard shadow cut, tilted head.

brilliance.name: Brilliance
brilliance.scene: She fires a beam of pure gold light from her open palm straight at the camera, the beam a bold flat shape, ribbons blown back.

devotion.name: Devotion
devotion.scene: Emblem composition: she kneels in prayer inside a pool of golden light with a flat radiant sun behind her.

worship.name: Worship
worship.scene: She kneels with her forehead lowered over folded hands, a shaft of gold light falling on her, ribbon pooling.

wreath_of_flame.name: Wreath of Flame
wreath_of_flame.scene: She holds the staff upright with a wreath of flat gold flames spinning around its head, her face calm, symmetric.

conjure_blade.name: Conjure Blade
conjure_blade.scene: Emblem composition: a golden sword forms in the air in front of her, blade in profile, she regards it with her head tilted, calm margins.

deus_ex_machina.name: Deus Ex Machina
deus_ex_machina.scene: A great shaft of gold light falls from above onto her while tiny winged figures of light circle in the air, a mechanical gold ring above, symmetric.

foreign_influence.name: Foreign Influence
foreign_influence.scene: She mimics the stance of a different ghostly fighter silhouette behind her, performing its kick, two overlaid poses, flat violet and gold.

omega.name: Omega
omega.scene: Emblem composition: stacked rings of gold light descend like a countdown above her head as she stands under them with her hands joined, calm margins.

reach_heaven.name: Reach Heaven
reach_heaven.scene: She lunges upward thrusting the staff at the sky and a beam opens a hole in the clouds, extreme low camera angle.

study.name: Study
study.scene: Emblem composition: she reads a floating scroll of abstract diagrams (no letters) by the glow of her gold eye sigil, a stack of books beside her.

establishment.name: Establishment
establishment.scene: She plants the staff upright like a pillar and a flat temple platform forms around it, symmetric emblem composition.

meditate.name: Meditate
meditate.scene: She sits cross-legged with a small gold orb floating above her open palm, calm, a flat cloudless sky behind.

perseverance.name: Perseverance
perseverance.scene: She braces against a strong wind with the staff planted and sleeves flapping in flat shapes, steady, low camera.

sands_of_time.name: Sands of Time
sands_of_time.scene: She smashes a golden hourglass with the staff and streams of gold sand burst outward, high angle, classroom-style shadow cut.

windmill_strike.name: Windmill Strike
windmill_strike.scene: She spins the staff in a big windmill circle overhead and brings it down, flat circular motion lines, low camera.

crescendo.name: Crescendo
crescendo.scene: She raises her arms and gold rings of sound grow larger and larger around her in a flat expanding series, wrath-tilted head.

flurry_of_blows.name: Flurry of Blows
flurry_of_blows.scene: Five rapid palm strikes shown as overlapping afterimage hands fanning across the frame, one clear fist in front.

flying_sleeves.name: Flying Sleeves
flying_sleeves.scene: Her wide sleeves fly out like blades slashing two bright gold arcs across the frame, low camera, cloudless sky.

protect.name: Protect
protect.scene: She shields herself behind the staff and one wide sleeve, a curved barrier arc of pale light in front, steady stance.

prostrate.name: Prostrate
prostrate.scene: She bows low with both hands on the floor and the ribbon pooling around her, a small gold orb floating over her head.

pray.name: Pray
pray.scene: She holds her hands together in prayer, gold light glowing between her palms, head tilted down, serene.

third_eye.name: Third Eye
third_eye.scene: Huge close-up of her blindfold with the gold closed-eye sigil glowing, a small pointed chin below, a calm flat panel behind.

cut_through_fate.name: Cut Through Fate
cut_through_fate.scene: She slices through one long gold thread of fate with the staff tip, flat star sparks, thread curling away in bold curves, low camera.

just_lucky.name: Just Lucky
just_lucky.scene: She tosses a small die and a coin together into the air with a small knowing tilt of her head, cloudless sky, flat gold highlights.

tranquility.name: Tranquility
tranquility.scene: She sits unmoving under a cloudless sky with a gentle ripple on the water, staff across her knees, still and symmetrical.

empty_mind.name: Empty Mind
empty_mind.scene: She sits with her head tilted as thoughts drift out of it like leaves of light, flat and quiet, a gold ring behind.

crush_joints.name: Crush Joints
crush_joints.scene: She twists an enemy silhouette's arm into a hold with both hands, non-graphic, flat violet shadow cut, low camera.

fear_no_evil.name: Fear No Evil
fear_no_evil.scene: She stands unflinching with one palm raised before a huge looming dark silhouette's strike, the staff planted, calm and symmetric.
